Airbnb, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the --palette-* ramps and the semantic bg / text / border / icon / status layer airbnb.com declares on :root, plus the --typography-*, --spacing-*, --corner-radius-*, --motion-*, --elevation-* and --material-* scales beside them. Where a name never appears on a painted element, the value is what the declaration resolves to; each token's exact provenance is in the tables.

Read from www.airbnb.com — which geo-redirected to www.airbnb.com.sg from this network; same design system, regional mirror — on 2026-11-09, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 (mobile at 390 x 844). The site pins data-color-scheme="light" and paints only light; the stylesheets still declare a full dark palette (the always-dark .c12bynq4 class and the .c1r7ywgw prefers-dark rebinds), so the Dark toggle shows those declared values, clearly never-applied on the capture. Airbnb Cereal VF is commercial and not loaded: the guide falls back to Inter. Component mock-ups are drawn with the tokens; the real components are the crops in components.md.

Palette

The ramps every semantic name is built on: rausch is the brand pink (#FF385C, the Bélo colour), arches the error red, beige the warm-neutral and grey the cool-neutral scale, then the blue / green / orange / purple / magenta / red support scales, shadow the translucent black steps, and the legacy named colours (hof, foggy, deco, faint, bobo, bebe, spruce, ondo, kazan) the older styles still read. Flip to Dark and the ramps invert where the stylesheet redeclares them.

Roles

The semantic layer the components actually read: color.bg.* surfaces (primary white, secondary #F7F7F7, inverse near-black, the core brand fill and its gradient variant), color.text.* (#222 primary, #6A6A6A secondary), color.border.*, color.icon.*, color.status.* and color.logo.*. Aliases point at the ramp step holding the same value; the Dark toggle swaps in the declared dark values.

TokenValueSource

Gradients

The brand gradients behind the Search submit and Reserve buttons, and the luxe/plus membership variants.

Typography

One face — Airbnb Cereal VF, variable from 300 to 800 — over a small set of named roles: titles for section heads, body for the interface, caption and subtitles for the quiet text, special.display for marketing heroes. The medium weight (500) carries most controls; semibold only on the biggest titles.

TokenValueSource

Space and shape

Spacing

The --spacing-micro-* (2-32) and --spacing-macro-* (16-80) steps. Component paddings land on them: 12/24 on the reserve card, 48 on the header's sides.

Radius

The --corner-radius-* scale. The listing photo takes large-16/xlarge-20 rounding by breakpoint, the search pill is a 100px capsule (measured, above the scale), buttons and fields take small-8.

Elevation

airbnb separates most surfaces with hairlines (elevation0 is a 1px inset #DDDDDD) and uses real drop shadows sparingly: high under the open search panel and the sticky header, primary/secondary/tertiary under cards and menus. The dark-elevation* levels are the dark theme's versions (declared, unapplied).

Motion

Two systems side by side: the legacy enter/exit/linear/standard cubic-bezier curves, and the next/springs sets written as linear() springs (shown as raw values; DTCG has no spring type). Component presses are 100ms transform scales; the 200-300ms fades ride the standard curve. Click a track to play it.

Material

The translucent bars (backdrop-filter + tinted ground) behind the sticky header and sheets.

TokenValueSource

Focus

Two ring styles: the category tabs draw a 2px #222 outline 4px out; every button draws it as a white 2px halo plus a #222 ring in box-shadow so it reads over fills. The measured token is measured.focus-ring.

Experiencestab: 2px outline, 4px offset
Type of placechip/button: white halo + #222 ring shadow
heart: the same ring over the photo

Layout

Read on the running home page at 1440 x 900. The header is a fixed 96px white bar padded 48; the search pill sits centred inside it; gallery rails then tile the content column.

header 1440 x 96, padding 48 — logo · tabs · host · globe · menu
search pill 850 x 66 — Where | When | Who + submit
section title + chevron
listing card photo, radius 20
card 182 x 215 at 1440
badge + heart over photo
footer link grid, 4 columns

On a phone (390 x 844) the header collapses to a compact search pill and the cards tile 165 x 199, two across. The results page splits the same card grid beside a map at desktop widths.

Dark theme

Toggle Dark above: the palette ramps and every semantic name swap to the values the stylesheets declare for the always-dark .c12bynq4 class and the .c1r7ywgw prefers-dark block — ground #111, text #F7F7F7, the ramps rebalanced. airbnb.com never applies it (every root pins data-color-scheme="light"); the set is kept for reference.
